checkpoints.name: idle_before_first_byte
checkpoints.description: Reset just released; transmitter is in IDLE with the line at logic 1.

checkpoints.name: first_start_bit_asserted
checkpoints.description: Transmitter is in START state and the line is held low for one bit time. The start bit begins at t=80 ns.

checkpoints.name: first_data_bit_lsb
checkpoints.description: Mid first data bit of byte 0x55. LSB of 0x55 is 1, so tx is high. 0x55 = 0b01010101, transmitted LSB-first: 1,0,1,0,1,0,1,0.

checkpoints.name: first_stop_bit
checkpoints.description: After 8 data bits, the transmitter raises tx for one bit time (the stop bit). The stop bit for byte 0x55 begins at t=78200 ns.

checkpoints.name: after_first_byte
checkpoints.description: First byte (0x55) has fully transmitted; the transmitter has returned to IDLE before the second byte starts.
